D: Indy and his father race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.
P: Serve the drinks when Indy has to choose the right cup.
S: Venice cod, prosciutto and sardine toasts
Baguette toasts with smoked cod, prosciutto and fig, or sardines and raisins
Toasts topped with whipped salt cod and parsley, prosciutto and fig, and marinated sardines with onion and raisins, Venetian bar style.
Circus train peanut caramel popcorn balls
young Indy running through the circus train

Popcorn and salted roasted peanuts bound in a golden syrup caramel, pressed into fist-sized balls and wrapped in paper like a circus stall treat. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot and tip into a large bowl with 150g roasted salted peanuts. Boil 200g caster sugar, 80g golden syrup, 60g butter and 3 tbsp water to 125C, then stir in half a teaspoon of bicarb and 1 tsp salt. Pour over the popcorn and toss with an oiled spoon. Shape into 12 balls with buttered hands, cool for 20 minutes and wrap each in baking paper.
Homemade soft pretzels with a camembert paprika butter dip
Pretzel dough proved, shaped, dipped in hot bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with obatzda of camembert, butter and paprika.
M: Hatay lamb kebabs with garlic yoghurt
the desert road to the canyon

Lamb mince with onion, garlic, sumac, chilli and parsley pressed onto skewers and grilled hot, with warm flatbread, charred tomatoes and garlic yoghurt. Grate 1 onion and squeeze out the juice. Knead 800g lamb mince with the onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp sumac, 1 tsp chilli flakes, a handful of chopped parsley and 1.5 tsp salt for 2 minutes. Press around 8 flat skewers and chill for 30 minutes. Grill on a very hot barbecue for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, with 4 halved tomatoes. Stir 1 grated garlic clove and a pinch of salt into 250g Greek yoghurt. Serve on warm flatbread with the tomatoes and yoghurt.
Crisp pork schnitzel with warm potato salad
Veal or pork schnitzel pounded thin, crumbed, fried in butter until golden and puffy, with lemon, warm potato salad and cucumber salad.
W: Almond and pistachio cake soaked in lemon rosewater syrup
Almond and pistachio cake baked at 170C for 40 minutes, soaked with rosewater and lemon syrup, crushed pistachios and rose petals on top.
K: Red wine, pomegranate juice, orange and brandy over ice, juice version for drivers

Red wine, pomegranate juice, orange and cinnamon steeped together and served cold in plain clay cups with pomegranate seeds, plus one gold goblet nobody touches. Warm 200ml pomegranate juice with 60g caster sugar, 1 cinnamon stick and 3 cloves until the sugar dissolves, then cool. Pour into a jug with a 750ml bottle of tempranillo or shiraz, another 200ml pomegranate juice, 1 sliced orange and 60ml brandy. Chill for at least 2 hours. Pour over ice into plain clay or wooden cups and scatter pomegranate seeds on top. Use red grape juice in place of the wine and brandy for anyone not drinking.

dishes.n: Venice cod, prosciutto and sardine toasts

steps.text: Boil the potato until soft. Poach the cod in milk for 8 minutes, then flake.
Beat the flaked cod with the potato and olive oil into a rough spread.
Toast the baguette slices.
Top a third with the cod spread and parsley, a third with prosciutto and fig, and the rest with sardines, onion and raisins.

veg.n: Venice smoked tofu, fig and eggplant toasts

steps.text: Boil the potato until soft.
Blitz the potato with the crumbled tofu, milk and 2 tbsp of the olive oil into a rough spread.
Fry the onion in the rest of the oil until soft, then add the raisins and vinegar and cook for 2 minutes.
Toast the baguette slices.
Top a third with the tofu spread and parsley, a third with gorgonzola and fig, and the rest with eggplant and the sweet and sour onions.

dishes.make_ahead: Best the day they are baked

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast and water into a dough and knead until smooth.
Prove until doubled in size.
Shape into pretzels and dip briefly in bicarb water. Sprinkle with salt.
Bake at 220C for 12 minutes.
Mash the camembert with the butter, paprika and onion for obatzda.

dishes.make_ahead: Boil and dress the potato salad up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; crumb the schnitzels up to 4 hours ahead and fry just before serving

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, slice and toss while warm with vinegar, oil and onion.
Pound the schnitzels thin. Crumb in flour, egg and panko.
Fry in butter and oil until golden and puffy.
Serve with the potato salad, sliced cucumber and lemon.

veg.make_ahead: Boil the potatoes and make the salad up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; salt, crumb and fry the eggplant on the night

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, slice and toss while warm with vinegar, 2 tbsp of the oil and onion.
Sprinkle the eggplant with salt and leave 10 minutes, pat dry, then crumb in flour, egg and panko.
Fry in the butter and remaining oil in batches until golden and soft inside.
Serve with the potato salad, sliced cucumber and lemon.

ingredients.item: pistachios, 100g ground and the rest crushed

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with most of the sugar, then fold in the almond meal and ground pistachios.
Bake in a lined tin at 170C for 40 minutes.
Simmer the remaining sugar with the lemon juice and a splash of water, add the rosewater and pour over the cake.
Top with crushed pistachios and rose petals.
Warm half the pomegranate juice with the sugar, cinnamon and cloves until the sugar dissolves, then cool.
Pour into a jug with the tempranillo or shiraz, the rest of the juice, orange slices and brandy.
Chill for at least 2 hours.
Pour over ice into cups and scatter pomegranate seeds on top.
Warm half the pomegranate juice with the sugar, cinnamon and cloves until the sugar dissolves, then cool.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, then lift them out.
Pour into a jug with the grape juice, the rest of the pomegranate juice and the orange slices.

s.n: Venice cod, prosciutto and sardine toasts
s.note: Baguette toasts with smoked cod, prosciutto and fig, or sardines and raisins
s.how: Poach 200g smoked cod in milk, flake and beat with a boiled potato and olive oil. Toast 12 baguette slices. Top four with the cod and parsley, four with prosciutto and fig, and four with sardines, onion and raisins.

s.note: Homemade soft pretzels with a camembert paprika butter dip
s.how: Make 8 pretzels from 400g flour, 7g yeast and 250ml warm water, dip in bicarb water, salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Mash 200g ripe camembert with 50g butter, 1 tsp paprika and a little onion for obatzda.

m.note: Crisp pork schnitzel with warm potato salad
m.how: Pound 4 pork schnitzels thin. Crumb in flour, 2 eggs and 150g panko and fry in butter and oil until golden and puffy. Toss 800g warm boiled potatoes with vinegar, oil and onion. Serve with cucumber salad and lemon.

w.note: Almond and pistachio cake soaked in lemon rosewater syrup
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs with 200g sugar, fold in 200g almond meal and 100g ground pistachios. Bake at 170C for 40 minutes. Simmer 100g sugar, lemon juice and 2 tsp rosewater and pour over. Top with crushed pistachios and rose petals.

d.note: Red wine, pomegranate juice, orange and brandy over ice, juice version for drivers

Pour over ice into plain clay or wooden cups and scatter pomegranate seeds on top. Use red grape juice in place of the wine and brandy for anyone not drinking.
